purpose: Teach: 情念/一躍/余力/立脚/密教/縛り/着色/周回

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人の情念を警察、心理学的に分析されてますね
lines.en: I see the police have been analyzing the suspect's psychological profile in this case.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful tone. Lean forward slightly on the opening phrase. Pace deliberate—a student working through implications. Quiet respect for the investigative process beneath the words.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、一躍世間の注目を集めた事件にも冷静に対応します
lines.en: The police respond with calm precision, even when a case attracts sudden public attention.
lines.style: Even, professional cadence. Each phrase weighted and deliberate. The tone of someone stating fact, not opinion. Slight pause before 'calm'—emphasis through restraint, not volume.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、人員の余力がない中、警察、ご対応ですね
lines.en: I can see how the police are managing the investigation despite limited staff resources on this case.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment. Softer attack than before. Pace slows slightly—recognizing the constraint without judgment. Small nod-like quality in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、事実に立脚した捜査を続けます
lines.en: We'll continue the investigation grounded in the facts.
lines.style: Quiet, steady resolve. No flourish. The tone of commitment, not defensiveness. Slight lift at the end—closing a statement, not opening a debate.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、密教団体の不審な動きを警察、警戒されますね
lines.en: The police are clearly watching closely for suspicious activity from the cult group in this case.
lines.style: Thoughtful again. Pace measured. A small hesitation before 'cult'—precision of language matters. Underlying current of concern, kept professional.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者を縛りつけた拘束器具を押収しました
lines.en: We've confiscated the restraint devices that were used to bind the victim.
lines.style: Direct, factual. No emotion leaking through. Clinical precision. The weight of what was actually found lands quietly in the pause before 'restraint'.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の着色した証拠物を警察、見破られましたね
lines.en: The police saw through the suspect's attempt to tamper with the evidence.
lines.style: Slight approval in the tone—professional respect for the investigative work. Pace steady. Emphasis on 'saw through'—subtle lift of competence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域を周回する巡回を強化します
lines.en: We're increasing patrols throughout the area.
lines.style: Firm, decisive. Direct eye contact implied in the delivery. Shorter, clipped phrases. The tone of action being taken, not just considered.
